title: TELOS
author: Iced-Cream
description: Mods kept on the Analog Rytm MKII itself (OS 1.74, core-ar2 0.18 or newer). It is elekloader's Drive Loader (mods/drive-loader-ar2, vendored) under TELOS's name: .elemod files in the +Drive's /mods folder, sent through the unit's own Data router (Elektron Transfer, Elektroid or elekloader mods), and at every boot the ones chosen in /mods/active are linked into the +Drive mods' area, with no new firmware. SETTINGS > GLOBAL > MODS (TELOS), with TELOS's gear, opens the Drive Loader's MODS page; a * marks a mod with saved data, and APPLY & RESTART reboots into a changed build, keeping the working project. Hold [NO] at power-on to skip the mods once; a crash guard skips them once after a start that didn't get 10 s in.
